{"reason": "Both stockout examples are medium-risk with <6 days inventory that got suggest-alternative-supplier, whose lead (7, 4) exceeded stock; alert-planner always arrives and costs 35000 vs 45000. Loosening the expedite gate to medium-risk and <6 days fixes medium 2.8/5.3 (195000→35000) and beats alt-supplier at high 5.4 (45000→35000), cutting cost and stockouts.", "source": "(define (expedite-response risk-level inventory-days)
  (cond
    ((and (>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium)) (< inventory-days 6))
     (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    ((>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium))
     (list 'suggest-alternative-supplier))
    (else (list 'monitor))))"}
